reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing getScheduledAmount and replaces three inline midpoint copies with calls to it, though the call sites keep a redundant `== null ? 0` check the helper already handles.

duplication.why: Adds no new copies, but leaves two pre-existing inline midpoint computations (schedule-template.ts createScheduleList and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions in shared/schedules.ts) duplicating the amount rule.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, where client and server already take the scheduled amount from.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, three call sites and a test.

maintainability.why: Mostly centralised, but two missed copies still apply the old midpoint and a stale 'rounded midpoint' comment remains in schedules/app.ts updateActions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList and shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions still compute the ranged amount inline instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic introduced by the diff.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount holds the new rule, but schedule-template.ts and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions keep their own midpoint computation, so not every path uses it.
